<p class="my-4">Project names can be up to 100 characters long and must be lowercase. They can include letters, digits, and the following characters: <code class="code-module__V4tPXG__code code-module__V4tPXG__inlineCode">.</code>, <code class="code-module__V4tPXG__code code-module__V4tPXG__inlineCode">\_</code>, <code class="code-module__V4tPXG__code code-module__V4tPXG__inlineCode">-</code>. However, they cannot contain the sequence <code class="code-module__V4tPXG__code code-module__V4tPXG__inlineCode">---</code>.</p>
<div class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__container"><h2 class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__header text-heading-20 sm:text-heading-24" data-components-heading="true"><span class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__target" id="build-and-development-settings"></span><a class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__title [&>p]:m-0" href="#build-and-development-settings">Build and development settings</a><a href="#build-and-development-settings" class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__permalink" aria-label="Copy link to section"><svg class="text-[0.6em]" data-testid="geist-icon" height="16" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:currentColor" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.46968 1.46968C10.1433 -0.203925 12.8567 -0.203923 14.5303 1.46968C16.2039 3.14329 16.2039 5.85674 14.5303 7.53034L12.0303 10.0303L10.9697 8.96968L13.4697 6.46968C14.5575 5.38186 14.5575 3.61816 13.4697 2.53034C12.3819 1.44252 10.6182 1.44252 9.53034 2.53034L7.03034 5.03034L5.96968 3.96968L8.46968 1.46968ZM11.5303 5.53034L5.53034 11.5303L4.46968 10.4697L10.4697 4.46968L11.5303 5.53034ZM1.46968 14.5303C3.14329 16.2039 5.85673 16.204 7.53034 14.5303L10.0303 12.0303L8.96968 10.9697L6.46968 13.4697C5.38186 14.5575 3.61816 14.5575 2.53034 13.4697C1.44252 12.3819 1.44252 10.6182 2.53034 9.53034L5.03034 7.03034L3.96968 5.96968L1.46968 8.46968C-0.203923 10.1433 -0.203925 12.8567 1.46968 14.5303Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></a></h2></div>
<p class="my-4">You can edit settings regarding the build and development settings, root directory, and the <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/deployments/configure-a-build#install-command">install command</a>. See the <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/deployments/configure-a-build">Configure a build documentation</a> to learn more.</p>
<p class="my-4">The changes you make to these settings will only be applied starting from your <span class="strong-module__WGWgwq__docsString">next deployment</span>.</p>
<div class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__container"><h2 class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__header text-heading-20 sm:text-heading-24" data-components-heading="true"><span class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__target" id="node.js-version"></span><a class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__title [&>p]:m-0" href="#node.js-version">Node.js version</a><a href="#node.js-version" class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__permalink" aria-label="Copy link to section"><svg class="text-[0.6em]" data-testid="geist-icon" height="16" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:currentColor" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.46968 1.46968C10.1433 -0.203925 12.8567 -0.203923 14.5303 1.46968C16.2039 3.14329 16.2039 5.85674 14.5303 7.53034L12.0303 10.0303L10.9697 8.96968L13.4697 6.46968C14.5575 5.38186 14.5575 3.61816 13.4697 2.53034C12.3819 1.44252 10.6182 1.44252 9.53034 2.53034L7.03034 5.03034L5.96968 3.96968L8.46968 1.46968ZM11.5303 5.53034L5.53034 11.5303L4.46968 10.4697L10.4697 4.46968L11.5303 5.53034ZM1.46968 14.5303C3.14329 16.2039 5.85673 16.204 7.53034 14.5303L10.0303 12.0303L8.96968 10.9697L6.46968 13.4697C5.38186 14.5575 3.61816 14.5575 2.53034 13.4697C1.44252 12.3819 1.44252 10.6182 2.53034 9.53034L5.03034 7.03034L3.96968 5.96968L1.46968 8.46968C-0.203923 10.1433 -0.203925 12.8567 1.46968 14.5303Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></a></h2></div>
<p class="my-4">Learn more about how to customize the Node.js version of your project in the <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/functions/runtimes/node-js/node-js-versions#setting-the-node.js-version-in-project-settings">Node.js runtime</a> documentation.</p>
<p class="my-4">You can also learn more about <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/functions/runtimes/node-js/node-js-versions#default-and-available-versions">all supported versions</a> of Node.js.</p>
<div class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__container"><h2 class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__header text-heading-20 sm:text-heading-24" data-components-heading="true"><span class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__target" id="project-id"></span><a class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__title [&>p]:m-0" href="#project-id">Project ID</a><a href="#project-id" class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__permalink" aria-label="Copy link to section"><svg class="text-[0.6em]" data-testid="geist-icon" height="16" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:currentColor" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.46968 1.46968C10.1433 -0.203925 12.8567 -0.203923 14.5303 1.46968C16.2039 3.14329 16.2039 5.85674 14.5303 7.53034L12.0303 10.0303L10.9697 8.96968L13.4697 6.46968C14.5575 5.38186 14.5575 3.61816 13.4697 2.53034C12.3819 1.44252 10.6182 1.44252 9.53034 2.53034L7.03034 5.03034L5.96968 3.96968L8.46968 1.46968ZM11.5303 5.53034L5.53034 11.5303L4.46968 10.4697L10.4697 4.46968L11.5303 5.53034ZM1.46968 14.5303C3.14329 16.2039 5.85673 16.204 7.53034 14.5303L10.0303 12.0303L8.96968 10.9697L6.46968 13.4697C5.38186 14.5575 3.61816 14.5575 2.53034 13.4697C1.44252 12.3819 1.44252 10.6182 2.53034 9.53034L5.03034 7.03034L3.96968 5.96968L1.46968 8.46968C-0.203923 10.1433 -0.203925 12.8567 1.46968 14.5303Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></a></h2></div>
<p class="my-4">Your project ID can be used by the REST API to carry out tasks relating to your project. To locate your Project ID:</p>
<ol class="my-3 list-decimal pl-6">
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Ensure you have selected your Team from the team switcher.</li>
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Choose your project from the <a href="https://vercel.com/d?to=%2Fdashboard&title=Open+Dashboard" rel="noopener" target="_blank" data-zone="null" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend">dashboard</a>.</li>
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Open <span class="strong-module__WGWgwq__docsString">Settings</span> in the sidebar.</li>
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Under <span class="strong-module__WGWgwq__docsString">General</span>, scroll down until you find <span class="strong-module__WGWgwq__docsString">Project ID</span>. The ID should start <code class="code-module__V4tPXG__code code-module__V4tPXG__inlineCode">prj_</code>.</li>
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Copy the Project ID to use as needed.</li>
</ol>
<div class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__container"><h2 class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__header text-heading-20 sm:text-heading-24" data-components-heading="true"><span class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__target" id="vercel-toolbar-settings"></span><a class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__title [&>p]:m-0" href="#vercel-toolbar-settings">Vercel Toolbar settings</a><a href="#vercel-toolbar-settings" class="linked-heading-module__rvMliW__permalink" aria-label="Copy link to section"><svg class="text-[0.6em]" data-testid="geist-icon" height="16" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:currentColor" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.46968 1.46968C10.1433 -0.203925 12.8567 -0.203923 14.5303 1.46968C16.2039 3.14329 16.2039 5.85674 14.5303 7.53034L12.0303 10.0303L10.9697 8.96968L13.4697 6.46968C14.5575 5.38186 14.5575 3.61816 13.4697 2.53034C12.3819 1.44252 10.6182 1.44252 9.53034 2.53034L7.03034 5.03034L5.96968 3.96968L8.46968 1.46968ZM11.5303 5.53034L5.53034 11.5303L4.46968 10.4697L10.4697 4.46968L11.5303 5.53034ZM1.46968 14.5303C3.14329 16.2039 5.85673 16.204 7.53034 14.5303L10.0303 12.0303L8.96968 10.9697L6.46968 13.4697C5.38186 14.5575 3.61816 14.5575 2.53034 13.4697C1.44252 12.3819 1.44252 10.6182 2.53034 9.53034L5.03034 7.03034L3.96968 5.96968L1.46968 8.46968C-0.203923 10.1433 -0.203925 12.8567 1.46968 14.5303Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></a></h2></div>
<p class="my-4">The Vercel Toolbar is a tool that assists you in iterating and developing your project and is enabled by default on preview deployments. You can enable or disable the toolbar in your project settings.</p>
<ul class="my-3 list-disc pl-6 [&>li::marker]:text-gray-500">
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Leave feedback on deployments with <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/comments">Comments</a></li>
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Navigate <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/vercel-toolbar#using-the-toolbar-menu">through dashboard pages</a>, and <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/vercel-toolbar#sharing-deployments">share deployments</a></li>
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Read and set <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/feature-flags">Feature Flags</a></li>
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Use <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/draft-mode">Draft Mode</a> for previewing unpublished content</li>
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Edit content in real-time using <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/edit-mode">Edit Mode</a></li>
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Inspect for <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/vercel-toolbar/layout-shift-tool">Layout Shifts</a> and <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/vercel-toolbar/interaction-timing-tool">Interaction Timing</a></li>
<li class="mb-2 pl-1 leading-[1.7] [&>svg]:inline-flex last:mb-0">Check for accessibility issues with the <a data-zone="same" class="link-module__Q1NRQq__link no-underline link-module__Q1NRQq__blend" href="/docs/vercel-toolbar/accessibility-audit-tool">Accessibility Audit Tool</a></li>
